d: A lean, athletic build fully encased in a high-tech, charcoal-grey and black tactical combat suit featuring glowing neon green accents on the chest, thighs, and boots. The head is covered by a sleek, dark metallic helmet with a glowing electric blue visor that obscures the face and eyes. A bulky mechanical backpack with protruding antennae is attached to the rear, and the hands are clad in reinforced armored gloves while holding a large, black futuristic shotgun with a red detail on the side. No hair, skin, or facial features are visible.
